description: The Cozy Vanila Modpack significantly improves the visuals of the game, adding more realistic animations and an overall cozier atmosphere. This makes Minecraft look much more alive and aesthetically pleasing without fundamentally changing the gameplay
body:
# Cozy Vanila

Cozy Vanila is a modpack focused on significantly improving Minecraft’s visuals while keeping the original vanilla gameplay experience intact. The modpack creates a calmer, cozier, and more immersive atmosphere through modern visual enhancements, realistic animations, and improved textures.

## What does the modpack add?

* More realistic mob and player animations
* Improved mob and environment textures
* Better clouds, lighting, and atmospheric effects
* Performance optimizations and smoother gameplay
* Subtle audio and visual improvements for a more cozy experience
* A more modern Minecraft look without drastically changing gameplay
* and more fps for smooth game play

## Who is this modpack for?

* Players who want a better-looking Minecraft experience without complicated mechanics
* Relaxing gameplay, building, and survival
* Players who enjoy the vanilla+ style

## Main Goal

The goal of Cozy Minecraft is to make Minecraft feel more visually appealing, lively, and atmospheric while preserving the simplicity and familiar feeling of the original game.
